company_stage: large North American energy infrastructure and utilities company

culture_principles.name: Public mission and customer-impact alignment
culture_principles.description: Enbridge fit should connect work to the company outcomes and users described in cited public sources.

culture_principles.name: Evidence-backed execution
culture_principles.description: Strong answers should show practical judgment, clear tradeoffs, ownership, and outcomes rather than generic enthusiasm.

culture_principles.name: Safety as a non-negotiable operating condition
culture_principles.description: Public material places safety alongside reliability for assets that carry energy near communities, so decisions are expected to be defensible before they are fast.

culture_principles.name: Reliability across a long-lived asset base
culture_principles.description: The business runs infrastructure with multi-decade lifetimes, which favours maintenance, integrity, and outage planning over short-term optimization.

culture_principles.name: Transition delivered through existing assets
culture_principles.description: Public positioning pairs conventional energy infrastructure with lower-carbon investments, so candidates should be able to hold both mandates at once.

hiring_signals.signal: Connects decisions to the users, customers, products, or markets named in public company sources.
Uses concrete examples to show ownership, learning, and measurable improvement.
Describes a decision where safety, regulatory, or environmental risk changed the technical plan.
Explains how they protected reliability during a maintenance, outage, or commissioning window.
Works with regulators, landowners, or Indigenous communities and can describe what changed after that engagement.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Generic admiration for the company without a concrete role, customer, product, or business mechanism.
anti_signals.risk_reason: Public lens usage should stay grounded in cited source signals and role-relevant evidence.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Treating pipeline operations and renewable development as interchangeable work with the same constraints.
anti_signals.risk_reason: Public sources describe materially different asset and regulatory contexts across the portfolio.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Assuming one regulatory regime applies across jurisdictions and asset types.
anti_signals.risk_reason: The lens spans multiple regions and business units; a single-regime assumption is not supported publicly.

interview_patterns.pattern: Use cited public source signals to test role-relevant judgment, ownership, communication, and impact.

honest_limits: This is a lightweight public-source lens and does not represent an official Enbridge hiring standard.
It contains source metadata and non-verbatim public-safe signals only.
Role, team, seniority, location, and hiring manager can materially change interview emphasis.
This lens requires deeper multi-source validation before being promoted to FULLY_DISTILLED.
